title: Reform and unit select
summary: Hold a unit to inspect it without giving an order. Reform now forms a line, then walks on together.
items: Hold a unit to see its type, line size, health, and bonuses.
Reform moves at half speed. The front waits until the rear forms a perfect line, then the line walks together.
A unit joining from behind takes reform unless that line already fills every row.
A full line keeps its order. A unit walking through it does not halt, reform, or charge that line.
Charge spreads only into a reforming line that still has an open row.
You start with 600 gold. Units and banks cost 20% more.

title: Ranked matchmaking
summary: Log in with Formbar to play ranked games, buy tickets, and climb the high scores.
items: Matchmaking pairs the closest MMR and waits up to a minute when the spread is wide.
Creating a listed lobby, joining a specific game, and ranked search each cost one ticket.
Bot games and random unranked games are free.
